what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at Town Hall; remote option via Zoom (Meeting ID: 909 174 0347, https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=82978397423) or phone (888) 475-4499; also broadcast on Lunenburg Public Access cable, Facebook Live, and YouTube.
preview.hook: Fire Chief contract, a new police officer, two public hearings, and Municipal Buildings/bridge updates
preview.one_line: Select Board (Sept 29, 7 PM, Town Hall): Fire Chief contract ratification, police officer hire, Earth Removal and auto-dealer hearings, Municipal Buildings.

items.agenda_line: Motion to enter into Executive Session and re-enter Open Session pursuant to MGL c. 30 § 21 (a)(2) to conduct strategy sessions in preparation for negotiations with nonunion personnel…or contract negotiations with nonunion personnel (Fire Chief).
items.why_it_matters: The Board is discussing contract negotiations with the Fire Chief behind closed doors before returning to open session.

items.agenda_line: Earth Removal Renewal Applications for P. J. Keating Company
items.why_it_matters: This public hearing covers renewing permits for gravel/earth removal operations at four properties in town.

items.agenda_line: Public Hearing: Class II Auto Dealer License for Cars Up Inc., Located at 149 Summer Street
items.why_it_matters: A public hearing on whether to license a used-car dealership at this Summer Street address.

items.agenda_line: Ratification of the Town Manager’s Appointment of Ian Pereira as Full-Time Police Officer effective October 5, 2026
items.why_it_matters: The Board is being asked to confirm a hiring decision for a full-time police officer.

items.agenda_line: Announcement of the Resignation of Lydia Paolilli as Assistant Library Director
items.why_it_matters: A resignation from a library leadership position is being announced, which residents who use the library may want to know about.

items.agenda_line: Announcement of the Resignation of Jane Paszko as Videographer
items.why_it_matters: A resignation from the town's videographer position, who records public meetings, is being announced.

items.agenda_line: Discussion and Potential Action Regarding Open Meeting Law Complaint Filed by Caesar Nuzzolo on September 15, 2026
items.why_it_matters: The Board may take action on a complaint alleging it violated the state's open meeting law.

items.agenda_line: Ratification of the Employment Agreement for Fire Chief
items.why_it_matters: The Board is being asked to formally approve the employment contract for the Fire Chief.

items.agenda_line: Designation of Polling Location(s), MGL Chapter 54, Section 24
items.why_it_matters: The Board is setting or confirming where residents vote, a service that affects every registered voter in town.

items.agenda_line: Update on Food Pantry License Agreement
items.why_it_matters: This is a status update on the agreement governing the town's food pantry, a service some residents rely on.

items.agenda_line: Update on Flat Hill Road Bridge Reconstruction Project
items.why_it_matters: This is a status update on the reconstruction of a town bridge, an infrastructure project affecting road access.

items.agenda_line: Consider Select Board Sponsored Warrant Articles
items.why_it_matters: The Board is considering which articles it will put forward for the November Special Town Meeting, where residents vote on town matters.
The Board is reviewing an early draft of the warrant for the upcoming Special Town Meeting.
The Board is discussing changes to its own policy for making appointments to town boards and committees.
The Board is discussing the status or use of town-owned municipal buildings.
